title: [Decision] Release cadence: a week of merges is about 1,700 PRs, so each QA-gated release carries a very large delta and app repos wait days to install fixes
body:
director#1 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzg12BtjFc5rHp7YD1J
Ruled: 6663894403 · letter B · 2026-11-05T16:47Z (lifts the suspension of 6583414011)

**Filing gate ②, a decision only the maintainer can make** (every publish is the maintainer's own act, AGENTS.md Prime Directive 15). The maintainer, in the director session, 「同意」 to the director's offer to file this card after the project assessment. ⛔ Not a claim. **Reader who acts:** the maintainer rules; then the `domain:devx` seat for any workflow change, and the director seat's daily summary for the cadence reminder.

## 维护者速读

- **问题**:合并速度约每周 1,700 个 PR,发布是人工 QA 把关后由您手动发,所以每次发布带的改动非常大,下游应用仓要等好几天才能装到修复。
- **实测**:18.0.0(10-20)、18.1.0(10-24)、18.2.0(10-27)约 3–4 天一发;18.3.0 的发版测试从 10-29 开始,现在第 4 波,刚出一轮 23 PASS / 4 FAIL;Version Packages PR #26517 已开 6 天,+57,972 / −17,952 行、1,354 个文件,待发 changeset 1,088 个。今天的决策卡 #29106 就是应用仓在 18.2.0 上实测出来的。
- **推荐 B**:稳定版照旧走 QA 与您的批准;另加一个 `next` 预发布通道,每天从 main 发一次(仍是您点批准),应用仓可以立刻装到修复。
- **代价**:您每天多一次批准点击;发布 workflow 要加一条快照发布路径(Tier H,需您批准)。
- **您要做的一个动作**:回一个字母(A / B / C)。

## Measured

| reading | value | re-check |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 18.x publish dates (npm `time`) | 18.0.0 10-20 12:51Z · 18.1.0 10-24 09:11Z · 18.2.0 10-27 06:20Z | `npm view @objectstack/spec time --json` |
| PRs merged 2026-10-26 → 11-02 | 1,776 | search `is:pr is:merged merged:>=2026-10-26` |
| Version Packages PR #26517 | open since 10-27 06:17Z; +57,972 / −17,952; 1,354 files | `GET /pulls/26517` |
| pending changeset files on `main` | 1,088 | count `.changeset/*.md` other than `README.md` |
| 18.3.0 release sweep | #27377 open since 10-29; wave 4 run #28981: 23 PASS / 4 FAIL | `GET /issues/27377` |

What would make the delta small instead: a release every day, or a channel that is installable without waiting for the sweep. Neither exists today; `next` was last used for 18.0.0-next.0 … next.5 under Changesets pre mode, exited by #24528.

## Governing text

- AGENTS.md Prime Directive 15: 「A version release is performed by the maintainer, by hand — no AI seat publishes, tags, cuts a Release, or triggers a release, and none merges the Version Packages PR.」 Every option keeps this.
- ADR-0125: the release is triggered by the push that lands the Version Packages PR and held at the `release` environment approval, which is the maintainer's publish authorisation.
- ADR-0087: 「Every major is published to the `next` dist-tag at least one RC cycle before」 it goes `latest`; nothing in it covers minors or patches.

## Options

| | what it does | what a customer notices | workload |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| **A** | Fixed stable cadence, e.g. Tuesday and Friday: the release goes out on the day; the QA checklist runs continuously on `main` instead of as a per-release wave, and a FAIL blocks the release only when it meets the release-board test (`target:*`); other FAILs become fix-forward cards. | Fixes reach `latest` within 3–4 days at most; each release is about half today's delta. | No workflow change. Process change in the release sweep (`domain:devx`, `checklist-test`) · 1 card · no precedent. |
| **B** | Stable stays as today. Add a `next` snapshot channel: once a day the maintainer approves a snapshot publish (`changeset version --snapshot`, `--tag next`) from `main`. App repos pin `next` when they need a fix now. | App repos install a fix the next day; `latest` users see no change. | `release.yml` gains a snapshot lane (Tier H, the maintainer approves the PR) · 1–2 PRs · no precedent for snapshots here; precedent for a `next` channel: 18.0.0-next.0–5 under pre mode. Plus one approval click a day. |
| **C** | Keep today's process: release when the RC sweep closes. | App repos wait for the sweep; deltas stay at about a week of merges. | None. |

## 四轴分析

- **项目长远合理性**:两年后成熟平台的发布形态是「稳定版按 QA 节奏 + 每日可安装的预发布通道」,Next.js 的 canary、React canary、Supabase CLI 的 beta 通道都是这样;稳定版不必为了快而降低把关。B 是这个形态;A 用节奏换增量大小,但仍要在快和稳之间二选一;C 让每次发布越来越大,出问题越难定位。
- **实际业务拉动**:有。应用仓按「可安装」解锁(跨仓解锁判据),今天 #29106 等卡就是应用仓在 18.2.0 上实测的;修复在 main 上已合,用户却装不到。
- **防 AI 犯错**:发布增量越大,发布后回溯哪个 PR 引入问题越难;B 让应用仓每天在真实安装面上验证,问题更早响亮暴露。A 也缩小增量。C 最差。
- **创业阶段不扩散**:A 不新增任何面;B 新增一个预发布通道和一条 workflow 路径,外加您每天一次点击;C 最省。

os-decision-facets
- ① 项目长远合理性:B 是稳定版 + 每日预发布的主流终态;A 缩小增量但仍在快与稳间取舍;C 增量持续变大。
- ② 实际业务拉动:有——应用仓按可安装解锁,今天的决策卡在 18.2.0 上实测;main 已合的修复装不到。
- ③ 防 AI 犯错:B 让应用仓每天在真实安装面上响亮暴露问题;A 次之;C 让回溯越来越难。
- ④ 创业阶段不扩散:A 无新面;B 新增一个通道与一条 workflow 路径及每日一次点击;C 最省。
Prior rulings read: "release" "next" "Version Packages" "cadence" → ADR-0125, ADR-0087 (next for majors), #24528 (exit pre mode), #21361 (Version PR behind main); thread: none

自检:只看①选 B;②③④ 是否翻转:否(④ 只影响时序:可先试行两周)。

**推荐:B。** A 不取:它用节奏缩小增量,但每次仍要在 QA 完整性和速度之间让步。C 不取:增量每周约 1,700 个 PR,持续变大。**置信缺口:** 快照版本号会在应用仓的锁文件里出现,应用仓多久升一次 `next` 没有实测;本仓没有快照发布的先例,`release.yml` 的改动规模未测。

Analysis-tier: `claude-opus-5-5` (served at filing; not `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`).

## 裁后执行

- **A:** one `domain:devx` card: continuous checklist runs on `main` and the release-board test as the only release block; the director's daily summary names the next release day.
- **B:** one `domain:devx` card for the snapshot lane in `release.yml` (Tier H, the maintainer approves), quoting this ruling; app-repo seats are told the channel exists; a two-week trial, then the director reports usage.
- **C:** this card closes `not_planned`.
